SELECT FEEDETAIL.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, DECODE(INFO.P_FINPROD_ID,NULL,NULL,INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID) AS fprodId, DECODE(INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,NULL, (SELECT PROD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD INFOADD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON INFOADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID WHERE INFOADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = DL.FINPROD_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ), DECODE(INFO.P_FINPROD_ID, NULL, INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, DL.FINPROD_ID)) AS prodId, DECODE(INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,NULL, (SELECT PROD.FINPROD_NAME FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD INFOADD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON INFOADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID WHERE INFOADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = DL.FINPROD_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ), INFO.FINPROD_NAME) AS prodName, FEINFO.FEE_ID feeId, FEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, FEINFO.ORG_TYPE feeType, DECODE(DL.FINPROD_TYPE2,'C04','11',FEINFO.ORG_TYPE2) feeSectype, DL.CCY ccy, FEEDETAIL.FEE_AMT amt, DL.SETTLE_DATE payDate, DECODE(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,NULL,'E','D') status, DL.REMARK remark, DL.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, NVL(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) AS updateTime FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DL
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON DL.FINPROD_ID = INFO.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL REVDL ON DL.TRADE_ID = REVDL.P_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL FEEDETAIL ON DL.TRADE_ID = FEEDETAIL.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO FEINFO ON FEINFO.FEE_ID = FEEDETAIL.FEE_ID
WHERE DL.PS = 'C11'
AND ((REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(DL.UPDATE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') != TO_CHAR(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NVL(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,REVDL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) OR (REVDL.UPDATE_TIME IS NULL AND NVL(DL.UPDATE_TIME,DL.CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ) and nvL(dl.p_trade_id,'NOREV') = 'NOREV' AND DL.IS_CANCEL IS NOT NULL
